# Changelog

## 2026-03-19
- [fix] **Workflow-run follow-ups are no longer conflated with Furnace session control.** Recent workflow-build conversations that later say “run/test/execute it” now get a dedicated `workflow_run` action hint that maps to `start_run`, while explicit Furnace wording still stays on `run_control` and `http_request`. This prevents ordinary workflow execution from being steered into `/api/furnace/*` session endpoints. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow build replies now surface the saved workflow identity more clearly, and run guidance is less ambiguous.** The codegen success path in `ChatManager` now says which current workflow ID the graph was saved to, includes the workflow name when present, and previews the first few node names instead of only reporting node/edge counts. Prompt guidance now also states that ordinary workflow execution should use `start_run` and should not use `http_request` / Furnace endpoints. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_graph_mutator.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow-build turns now self-repair small compilation/validation mistakes internally instead of surfacing them immediately.** The mutation retry loop now uses a dedicated repair prompt with structured context: user request, current workflow summary, the proposed mutation plan, and the exact compilation/validation failures. The model is instructed to preserve the user's requested workflow behavior and only fix mechanical graph-compilation, schema, or validation issues. Both `MutationPlan` validation exceptions and `GraphMutator` dry-run failures are caught and passed through the same bounded repair loop (max 2 attempts by default). The fallback text-streaming path also now catches plan-validation crashes instead of aborting the entire turn. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_graph_mutator.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow chat now covers the basic preview → apply → run loop much more smoothly.** Approval turns like `good please apply` now stay in the workflow-edit lane instead of falling back to Ask/read-only mode, chat gained a first-class `apply_last_mutation` capability for applying the latest proposed workflow preview from the current thread, `ChatManager` now persists the latest proposed mutation preview in thread metadata so later apply turns have a reliable server-side target, and `GraphMutator` now safely handles remove-then-recreate plans for reused node IDs such as `workflow_input` without tripping duplicate-ID dry-run failures. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_graph_mutator.py -q`.
- [perf] **Server startup reduced from ~33s to ~1s by deferring heavy memory kernel imports to background threads.** `ConversationAdapter.import_all` (scans full chat history) and `ProfileAdapter.import_profile` now run in `asyncio.to_thread()` background tasks instead of blocking the lifespan. Self-knowledge RAG indexing, telemetry pruning, and experience imports are also deferred. Added per-phase timing to the lifespan (logged at INFO) to catch future regressions. Also increased `dan-up`'s health timeout from 25s to 60s and stopped killing slow-starting servers on timeout.
- [feat] **Development-mode copy/paste now behaves more like Cursor when pasting code into chat.** `MonacoTabs.tsx` now remembers the active file path plus selected line range on normal editor copy, and `editor/src/lib/clipboardContext.ts` plus the `ChatPanel` / `ModeChatSidebar` paste handlers now reconstruct that metadata into a chat-friendly code context block (`path + line range + fenced code`) when the copied text is pasted back into DAN chat. The clipboard plain-text payload remains raw code so external pastes keep the usual behavior, while same-app chat paste can still recover file+line context through HTML metadata or the in-memory last-copy fallback. Review follow-up also tightened the plain-text fallback matcher to avoid false positives on ordinary comments and added HTML-entity decoding for quoted code. Validation: `cd editor && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/clipboardContext.test.ts` and `cd editor && npm run build`.
- [fix] **Kimi-backed low-budget report generations no longer burn their output budget on hidden reasoning, and the watchlist equity workflow validates end-to-end again.** `OpenAIProvider` now routes Moonshot's `thinking` control through `extra_body`, auto-disables thinking for low-budget non-tool `kimi-k2.5` calls with the documented non-thinking temperature, and falls back to regular completion text when Kimi streaming yields empty deltas. Also cleaned `_scratch` summary extraction so the aggregate watchlist index renders a readable recommendation line instead of markdown fragments. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_providers/test_model_selector_provider_resolution.py tests/test_providers/test_openai_provider_streaming.py -q` plus live `_scratch` reruns against the watchlist CSV.
- [fix] **Review patch: `/cost` now reads citation-summary metadata from the current request’s chat thread instead of guessing the workflow.** The fast-command path already receives `workflow_id` / `thread_id` in `SurfaceMessage.metadata`, but `/cost` previously preferred an active project's linked workflow or `capability_context.workflow_id`, which could point at the wrong thread and hide/show the wrong citation counts. `runtime.py` now prefers request-scoped metadata first, with a focused regression in `tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_terminal_output.py -q`.
- [fix] **Review patch: citation verification no longer bleeds across different claims that cite the same source index.** `build_citation_records()` now matches verification results by `(citation_index, normalized claim_text)` instead of source index alone, so a verified numeric claim like `24% in 2025 [1]` does not incorrectly mark another claim citing `[1]` as verified. Added a focused regression in `tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_terminal_output.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.
- [feat] **Closed the remaining Phase 39 citation follow-ups.** Anthropic-native citations are now extracted from raw assistant payloads into structured `CitationRecord` / verification data even when the assistant does not emit `[N]` markers, chat replay has a focused regression proving structured search-result blocks survive the `ChatManager` tool loop, unverified numeric/date claims now surface as separate non-terminal `chat_notice` warnings instead of mutating the assistant answer, and `/cost` now includes the latest citation verification summary from thread metadata. Follow-up hardening added explicit regressions for terminal-output collapsing, editor stream handling of `chat_notice`, and broader chat-router/visibility coverage. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_terminal_output.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_providers/test_anthropic_provider.py tests/test_search_models.py tests/test_concierge/test_chat_router.py tests/test_concierge/test_visibility_feedback.py -q` and `cd editor && npm run test -- --run src/lib/__tests__/editorChat.test.ts`.
- [feat] **Landed the main Phase 39 web-search hardening slice across search, chat, provider replay, and CLI docs.** Added canonical `SearchResultSet` / citation models plus audit persistence, intent-aware auto-grounding with query-relevant fetched excerpts, `/search` and lightweight `@web` triggers, heuristic query decomposition + ranking + canonical-URL dedup, Serper/provider-health/domain/location controls, per-turn web budgets, and post-response citation verification metadata. Anthropic raw replay now preserves structured `search_result` tool blocks, `.env.example` / CLI / README docs now advertise the new search controls, and focused regressions cover live-data grounding, explicit `/search`, shared search models, structured source extraction, and Anthropic structured replay. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_providers/test_anthropic_provider.py tests/test_search_models.py -q`.
- [docs] **Reconfirmed that the valuable trust hardening remains in-scope for Phase 28 instead of being deferred away.** After a third review of the `39-*` web-search plans, the phase now explicitly keeps both native-provider citation support (`39-1` task 4) and narrow citation verification (`39-5`) as phase-tail work because this is the dedicated web-search wave and there may not be another clean opportunity later. The rollout is still staged: `39-2` / `39-4` / `39-3` plus the minimal `39-1` contract slice land first, then the phase closes with the bounded hardening that still provides clear trust value.
- [docs] **Re-scoped Phase 28 web-search plans around fast quality wins versus optional later trust hardening.** The second review concluded that full native citation plumbing (`39-1` task 4) and post-response citation verification (`39-5`) are not required for the first substantial improvement in search quality. Updated the umbrella plan and `docs/todo.md` to make the rollout order explicit: initial focus is `39-2`/`39-4`/`39-3` plus only the minimal `39-1` contract slice. Also added three concrete medium-effort wins directly into the active plans: adaptive fetch fallback in `39-2`, canonical-URL dedup/source tracking in `39-3`, and explicit per-turn web budgets in `39-4`.
- [docs] **Reviewed and hardened the new Phase 28 web-search plans before implementation.** Patched the `39-*` plan set to align with the real architecture: (1) `39-1` now treats native Anthropic citations as a provider/chat-manager replay-path change rather than a simple handler tweak, preserves fetched excerpts for generic tool loops, uses a canonical `search_result_set` payload, and targets a real shared module path (`src/dan/server/search_models.py`) instead of a non-existent `server/models/` package; (2) `39-2` now routes `/search` through the canonical command registry and uses token-safe `@web` detection / future structured-mention integration; (3) `39-3` keeps URL dedup state local to a tool loop instead of a shared `ChatManager` attribute and avoids over-filtering repeated searches down to zero evidence; (4) `39-4` adds cache-key evolution, preserves explicit provider-order semantics unless a provider is in temporary cooldown, validates mutually exclusive domain filters, and bounds provider fan-out when combined with multi-query search; (5) `39-5` now uses post-response warning events / audit metadata instead of trying to mutate already-streamed assistant text with a late disclaimer.
- [docs] **Created Phase 28 — Web Search Hardening plans (39-1 through 39-5).** Umbrella plan `39-web-search-hardening.md` plus five sub-plans covering: (A) structured `SearchResult`/`CitationRecord` models with Anthropic native citation adapter, (B) intent-aware auto-grounding, query-relevant excerpt extraction, `/search` command, and `@web` mention, (C) multi-query decomposition, TF re-ranking, credibility tiers, cross-turn URL dedup, and thin-result reformulation, (D) Serper (Google) provider, configurable cascade, health tracking, domain/location controls, and multi-provider mode, (E) post-response citation verification and ungrounded-claim detection. Design informed by Claude API's `search_result` blocks and Cursor's `@Web` force-search UX.
- [feat] **Workflow chat now supports end-to-end build-and-run in a single conversational turn.** `plan_graph_mutations` gains an `auto_apply` parameter: when `true` and the dry-run passes, the server applies the mutation and saves the graph immediately, then continues the tool loop so the model can call `start_run` in the same turn. `ChatMutationEvent` now carries an `applied` flag and `_format_mutation_preview_content` surfaces "Built and applied — ready to run" instead of "proposed, not applied yet". Prompt guidance teaches the model to set `auto_apply: true` when the user asks to build AND run/test, and to leave it `false` for preview-only requests. Review hardening: (1) the auto-apply path now marks `plan_graph_mutations` as satisfied so the follow-up tool choice is `auto` instead of being forced back to `plan_graph_mutations`, and (2) text-based mutations with `auto_apply` use a `user` message continuation instead of a `tool` result message, avoiding the API contract violation of orphaned tool result messages. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py -q`.
- [fix] **`dan-up` no longer kills a slow-starting server prematurely.** Increased `wait_for_health` timeout from 25s to 60s (server startup now takes ~35s with all subsystems). When the timeout does fire, `dan-up` now distinguishes a still-alive server (leaves it running, suggests retrying) from a dead process (cleans up PID file). Previously, any startup exceeding 25s caused `dan-up` to SIGTERM/SIGKILL the server and report failure. Removed unused `signal` import.
- [fix] **Workflow-action follow-ups no longer get stranded in Ask mode with read-only workflow tools.** Audit-log turns like “Sounds good, can you run this workflow to test?” were still reaching `ChatManager` as `mode=ask`, which restricted the prompt to `**Workflow:** list_graphs` plus read-only run/file tools and let the model say it could not build/delete workflows. `src/dan/server/concierge/tier_executors.py` now promotes Ask-mode follow-ups back to `agent` when recent history clearly shows active workflow work and the new turn is operational (`run`, `test`, `build`, `delete`, etc.). Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow inventory + delete chat turns no longer execute speculative stale deletes in the same tool batch.** `src/dan/server/chat_manager.py` now defers `delete_graph` when the same provider response also asked for workflow inventory (`list_graphs`, `list_my_workflows`, `search_workflows`), then injects a follow-up instruction telling the model to delete only exact `graph_id` values from the fresh inventory result. `src/dan/server/capability_handlers.py` also resolves exact workflow-name matches back to `graph_id` and treats already-absent workflows as a safe no-op, which removes the confusing red “not found” tool failures when a workflow is already gone. `src/dan/server/chat/prompts.py` now teaches this delete sequencing explicitly. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow chat now keeps the right workflow tools visible on follow-up turns and can delete named workflows directly.** `src/dan/server/concierge/tier_executors.py` now preserves `plan_graph_mutations` for workflow-oriented follow-ups when recent history already shows workflow build activity, which fixes audit-log cases where turns like "so is it gonna work?" were prompted with `**Workflow:** list_graphs` only and then claimed they could not build. `src/dan/server/capability_handlers.py` now exposes write-mode `delete_graph` with `_scratch`/invalid-id guards, and the obsolete equity workflow JSONs were removed from `graphs/` so the local catalog no longer advertises stale research flows. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py -q` and `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow-build chat now distinguishes proposed mutation previews from applied/tested work and shows clearer workflow-preview progress.** `src/dan/server/chat/prompts.py` now teaches workflow-build turns that `plan_graph_mutations` only prepares a proposed preview/diff until the user applies it, while `src/dan/server/chat_manager.py` emits server-authored `chat_mutation` summaries plus concise workflow-preview `progress_ack` labels for prepare/repair/refresh phases. On the editor side, `ChatPanel.tsx`, `ModeChatSidebar.tsx`, `editorChat.ts`, `backgroundStreamRegistry.ts`, `toolCallPresentation.ts`, and the new `chatProgress.ts` helper now prefer `phase_label` text for progress displays, give `plan_graph_mutations` workflow-specific progress copy, and replace stale preview wording with an applied summary after mutation apply. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`, `cd editor && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/editorChat.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/toolCallPresentation.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/chatProgress.test.ts`, and `cd editor && npm run build` (build passes; Vite warns that Node 20.19+ is preferred, local machine is on 20.17.0).
- [fix] **Adapter status polling now accepts both async Telegram snapshots and sync WhatsApp snapshots, and `dan-chat` exits quietly on `Ctrl-C`.** `src/dan/server/routers/adapters.py` now routes heartbeat refreshes plus `/api/adapters/status` / config-summary reads through one helper that normalizes either synchronous or awaitable `get_connection_snapshot()` implementations, which removes the desktop-side Telegram coroutine warning while preserving the existing WhatsApp status path. `src/dan/cli/chat.py` now uses a best-effort quiet close during shutdown and swallows top-level `KeyboardInterrupt`, so leaving `dan-chat` with `Ctrl-C` no longer dumps a `CancelledError` traceback after `dan-up`. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_server/test_adapters_api.py` and `tests/test_cli/test_chat.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_server/test_adapters_api.py tests/test_cli/test_chat.py -q`.
- [fix] **CLI server lifecycle now treats zombie PIDs as dead, and unknown-model chat replies no longer crash while appending cost.** Added `src/dan/cli/process_utils.py` so `dan-up`, `dan-down`, `dan-service`, and `dan-status` all reject defunct `server.pid` targets instead of trusting raw `kill(pid, 0)` on Unix after interrupted launcher sessions. Also hardened `src/dan/server/chat_manager.py` so every `DAN_SHOW_COST` suffix branch first checks `cost is not None`, which prevents terminal `chat_complete` paths from failing when `estimate_cost(...)` has no pricing entry for the active model. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_cli/test_up.py`, new `tests/test_cli/test_down.py`, and `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_cli/test_service.py tests/test_cli/test_up.py tests/test_cli/test_down.py -q` and `python -m pytest tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.
- [fix] **Auto-mode chat no longer relabels backend `progress_ack` heartbeats into fake terminal `agent` completions.** `src/dan/server/routers/chat.py` now preserves an event's own `detected_mode` when one is already present and only backfills the request-level auto-detected mode onto terminal chat events that did not declare one themselves. This keeps `progress_ack` heartbeats non-terminal, so full-screen chat does not close the socket early and miss later tool-call / `chat_mutation` events. Added a focused regression in `tests/test_concierge/test_chat_router.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_chat_router.py -q`.
- [fix] **Research/Development AI sidebars now expose the same core thread and branch controls as full Chat instead of acting like second-class chat surfaces.** `editor/src/components/shared/ModeChatSidebar.tsx` now loads `_scratch` chat history from the server, shows a real history list plus `New chat` controls, and reuses the same branching semantics as `ChatPanel` for `Edit and resend in new branch`, `Regenerate in new branch`, and `Explore from here`. A follow-up review patch now also persists the current sidebar thread before switching history entries or starting a new chat, so the added history controls do not drop debounce-pending turns. The shared sidebar still keeps its mode-specific surface context enrichment for Research/Development prompts, but it no longer hides the chat-history and branch workflow behind the maximize handoff. Added focused Vitest coverage in `editor/src/components/shared/__tests__/ModeChatSidebar.test.ts`. Validation: `cd editor && npx vitest run src/components/shared/__tests__/ModeChatSidebar.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/chatThreadRestore.test.ts` and `cd editor && npm run build`.
- [fix] **Full-screen chat now preserves reconnect eligibility even when the first websocket closes before React commits the new active channel id.** `editor/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx` now mirrors the active `chat-*` channel into its ref immediately when connecting/clearing the socket, matching the existing run-stream/sidebar behavior so premature clean closes can still retry instead of leaving `_scratch` threads stuck at the first `"Working on it — Understanding your request"` progress ack. Validation: `cd editor && npm run test -- --run src/lib/__tests__/chatStreamLifecycle.test.ts` and `cd editor && npm run build` (build passes; Vite warns that Node 20.19+ is preferred, local machine is on 20.17.0).
- [fix] **Desktop-editor language servers no longer depend on starting the app from `editor/`.** `editor/electron/lspManager.ts` now resolves bundled Node-based language-server bins from the app's own `node_modules`, launches them via `process.execPath` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`, and passes the workspace root as child `cwd`, so JSON/CSS/HTML/TypeScript/Python servers work in packaged or cwd-shifted app runs instead of falling into npm 404 crash/restart loops. Also moved `typescript`, `typescript-language-server`, `pyright`, and `vscode-langservers-extracted` into editor runtime dependencies, added a focused launch-path regression in `src/__tests__/lspManager.test.ts`, and revalidated Electron compilation. Validation: `cd editor && npm run test -- --run src/__tests__/lspManager.test.ts` and `cd editor && npm run electron:compile`.
- [docs] **Marked resolved findings directly in the March 19 review docs.** Updated `2026-03-19-chat-dispatch-review.md`, `2026-03-19-workflow-generation-review.md`, `2026-03-19-concierge-triage-review.md`, `2026-03-19-general-project-health-review.md`, and `2026-03-19-user-experience-review.md` so items already fixed are explicitly labeled `Addressed` or `Partially addressed`, while still-open findings remain clearly open.
- [fix] **Full-screen chat startup now prefers the actual last-used chat for that workflow/workspace instead of a broader workspace fallback.** `editor/src/lib/chatThreadRestore.ts` now prioritizes explicit in-session handoffs first, then the workflow-scoped persisted full-screen selection, and only then falls back to the workspace-wide active thread id. This fixes cases where startup reopened an older or sidebar-derived `_scratch` thread even though the correct last-used full-screen chat had already been saved under the workspace-scoped restore key. Added a focused Vitest regression in `editor/src/lib/__tests__/chatThreadRestore.test.ts`. Validation: `cd editor && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/chatThreadRestore.test.ts`.
- [fix] **Closed all remaining Review Hardening Round 2 items (38-6 through 38-10) and removed fixed token caps from concierge LLM helpers.** (1) Removed hard-coded `_DECOMPOSITION_MAX_TOKENS=160` and `_SYNTHESIS_MAX_TOKENS=900` constants from `tier_executors.py` — lightweight concierge LLM calls now use the provider's natural limits instead of artificial caps, since `max_tokens` is an upper bound and the model stops at natural completion regardless. (2) Added `validateWritePath()` to `editor/electron/main.ts` that mirrors the backend `validate_path()` logic — resolves paths via `fs.realpathSync`, checks `DAN_STRICT_SANDBOX` + `DAN_WORKSPACE_ROOT`, and blocks writes/deletes/renames/mkdir outside the workspace root. Applied to `fs:writeFile`, `fs:delete`, `fs:rename`, `fs:mkdir`, and `search:replaceInFile` (which also now gets `expandHome` treatment). (3) Added `tests/test_security/test_exec_builtins_audit.py` — AST-walks all Python source under `src/dan/` for `exec()`/`eval()` calls and verifies each has `__builtins__` restriction within its surrounding context, with an exemption mechanism for intentionally different patterns (currently only `engine/conditions.py` with its stricter `_SAFE_BUILTINS`). Stale exemptions are also flagged. (4) Verified all 206 shell-related tests pass with `DAN_SANDBOX_SHELL=1`. (5) Verified triage latency is unaffected by the `max_tokens=256` budget since the model stops at natural JSON completion (~100-150 tokens). Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_security/test_exec_builtins_audit.py -q` and `cd editor && npx vitest run src/__tests__/validateWritePath.test.ts`.
- [feat] **Finished the cross-platform dev-mode hardening slice: extension-contributed language providers now round-trip into Monaco, and crashed language servers self-heal with user-visible restart notices.** The Electron extension host worker now keeps completion/hover/definition provider objects alive, assigns provider IDs, and answers `invokeLanguageProvider` IPC requests instead of only emitting one-way registration events. A new renderer bridge in `editor/src/lib/extensionLanguageProviders.ts` dynamically registers/disposes Monaco providers from extension-host events, and `useMonacoLsp.ts` now listens to that bridge so extension-provided completions actually appear in the editor. `LspManager` now stores root URIs, retries unexpected exits after 1s/2s/4s backoff (max 3 attempts), and emits custom `$/dan/serverStatus` notifications; the renderer turns those into warning/error toasts via the existing `lsp:notification` channel. Validation: `npm run test -- --run src/lib/__tests__/extensionLanguageProviders.test.ts src/__tests__/lspManager.test.ts`.
- [feat] **Tier-2 concierge decomposition and synthesis now have real lightweight LLM paths with deterministic fallbacks, and interrupted terminal streams no longer look “completed.”** `tier_executors.py` now makes decomposition reachable even when triage omitted explicit subtasks by using `_fallback_split_task()` as the initial gate, then attempting a cheap direct provider completion to request JSON subtasks. Final multi-child synthesis now optionally uses a lightweight provider completion (`aggressive` always, `balanced` for 3+ children, `careful` never) and falls back to the existing deterministic `## child` concatenation when the provider is unavailable or the synthesis call fails. Also tightened completion semantics: interrupted terminal events in single-shot/direct tier-2 execution now mark the session tree cancelled/paused instead of completed, and `SessionResult.metadata["completion_status"]` plus `SessionState` now drive task finalization. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py -q`.
- [test] **Workflow-query routing now has an end-to-end non-broadening regression.** Added a tier-1 concierge test proving a `workflow_query`-only route still reaches chat with `allow_mutation_tool=False`, so read-only workflow questions do not silently regain mutation capability through executor wiring. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py -q`.
- [fix] **Closed the next UX/security follow-up slice: CLI progress now uses the shared renderer, startup health is summarized, and strict sandbox cases are fully regression-tested.** `cli/chat.py` now routes streamed `progress_ack` events through a new `_CliProgressDisplay` helper backed by `CLIProgressRenderer`, so queued and foreground REPL streams show renderer-formatted phase/heartbeat updates while respecting `full` / `compact` / `minimal` verbosity. `startup.py` now records degraded subsystems into `AppState.startup_degradations`, emits a single WARNING-level startup summary after initialization, mirrors that state into `/health`, and the `dan-chat` banner now shows `Startup: ok` or `Startup: degraded (...)` alongside model/tier/learning status. Also expanded strict-sandbox coverage in `test_phase31_review_hardening.py` to lock in relative-path pass, absolute-in-workspace pass, absolute-outside-workspace reject, and symlink-escape reject behavior. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_phase31_review_hardening.py -q`.
- [feat] **Closed six remaining Round 2 plan items across error UX, planner transparency, dead-code cleanup, and onboarding.** (1) Added `_friendly_chat_error()` to `chat_manager.py` — all 5 raw `ChatErrorEvent` sinks and the router-level `chat_error` now map KeyError, 401, 429, timeout, connection, and 5xx patterns to actionable user messages instead of raw exception strings. (2) Legacy planner fallback is no longer silent: `gateway/router.py` broadcasts a `notification` event with `level=warning`, `controller.py` emits a WARNING log, and `app.py:_run_workflow()` propagates `warning`/`legacy_fallback` in its return dict. (3) Removed vestigial `CoverageChecker` and `CoverageResult` from `intent_compiler.py`, `dan.meta.__init__`, and `test_intent_compiler.py` — `IntentCompiler.compile()` is the sole gate. (4) Created `.env.minimal` with just `DAN_LLM_API_KEY` / `DAN_LLM_BASE_URL` / `DAN_LLM_MODEL` for fastest-possible setup; README Quick Start now offers both minimal and full config paths. (5) Documented `DAN_SANDBOX_SHELL` and `DAN_STRICT_SANDBOX` in `.env.example` Cost & Safety section. (6) Fixed `docs/cli.md` `DAN_SHOW_COST` default from `0` to `1` to match code. ## 2026-03-18
- [fix] **Workflow-build chat turns can now generate valid `for_each` bodies instead of getting trapped on missing `body_graph` validation errors.** `GraphMutator` now auto-scaffolds empty body sub-graphs when control-flow nodes such as `for_each` / `composite` are added, exposes a new `replace_body_graph` mutation op for populating those nested bodies, and updates the built-in `fan_out` pattern to emit a real body sub-graph instead of an impossible top-level shape. Prompt/schema guidance in `chat/prompts.py` plus the runtime workflow-tool hint in `chat_manager.py` now explicitly teach the model to add the control-flow node first and then define its body with `replace_body_graph`, including the important distinction that top-level `for_each` ports are `items` / `results` while `item` belongs inside the body sub-graph entry node. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_graph_mutator.py`, `tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py`, and revalidated adjacent chat follow-up coverage with `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py`. Validation: `pytest tests/test_graph_mutator.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.

## 2026-03-18
- [fix] **Workflow-build chat turns now spend less time stalled between discovery and mutation, and harmless mutation drifts no longer blow up dry-run retries.** `ChatManager.send_message_with_tools()` now injects the existing required-action retry prompt into post-tool follow-up turns when the provider cannot be forced onto a specific tool and `workflow_edit` is still missing, so Kimi/auto-compatible turns get an explicit “call `plan_graph_mutations` now” nudge instead of another vague continuation pass. `GraphMutator` now treats `remove_node` on already-missing nodes as an idempotent no-op and normalizes guessed source ports onto the declared port for single-output nodes (including the recurring `for_each.item -> results` and `code_operator.output -> result` drifts), which prevents unnecessary mutation auto-retry loops on workflow-build plans. Added regressions in `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py` and new `tests/test_graph_mutator.py`. Validation: `pytest tests/test_graph_mutator.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`, plus live browser replay after restart that reached `plan_graph_mutations` after a short 2-tool discovery pass instead of getting stuck in the earlier 4-tool discovery-only stall.

- [docs] **Plan 31-33 clarified child-session subagent model and parent-side synthesis review.** Applied two design decisions: (1) child sessions are subagents that inherit context, autonomy, and a synthetic triage from the parent — they do not re-triage or re-run context gathering, so context-gathering changes only affect the root dispatch path; (2) review/remediation is parent-side — after children complete, `_synthesize()` checks results against the original goal and can spawn at most one remediation child (for `aggressive`), replacing the previous plan's auto-injected review children and follow-up children that risked runaway self-review loops. Also clarified the `_build_prompt()` vs `interaction_policy` boundary: `_build_prompt()` carries factual metadata only, behavioral instructions live exclusively in the `interaction_policy` prompt module. Autonomy now propagates through the session tree as a first-class field on `Session`, and every tier head (root or child) adjusts its orchestration behavior: context-gathering depth, decomposition threshold, auto-injected review children, tool loop budget, completion standard/self-review, and per-session prompt enrichment. Pipeline execution: read phase (PDF via hybrid mode, URL via web_fetch) → five-pass LLM furnace (normalize → extract → aggregate → infer → project) with per-source status tracking, budget ceiling enforcement, and artifact persistence at `~/.dan/furnace/artifacts/{session_id}/`. **Frontend:** Added 10 typed API client functions in `api.ts` including `furnaceConnectSSE` for EventSource. `FurnacePanel` now calls backend API (create → add sources → start), with session name input, SSE-driven live progress, and pause/resume/cancel wired. `DistillationTab` listens for SSE events and updates progress/results in real time; Export Recipe wired to `furnaceGetRecipe`. `researchEventRouter` handles 10 furnace SSE event types. `useResearchStore` TrainingSession updated with `sessionId`/`recipeId` and backend sync action. **PDF upgrade:** Added `mode="hybrid"` (text-first, vision on flagged pages), page classification heuristic (low text, Figure/Table markers, equation indicators), equation-aware vision prompt, `_extract_structure` for section heading detection, `mode="structured"` stub. **Workflows:** Added `build_source_reader_workflow` (batch reader), `build_chunked_extraction_workflow` (chunked long-paper extraction), `_chunk_by_sections` helper; updated extraction prompt with structure extraction and aggregation prompt with section pattern detection. **Quality:** Cost estimation endpoint, budget ceiling with pause-on-exceed, multi-source type detection (paper/notebook/blog/doc) with URL/file heuristics, source metadata in session. **Tests:** 20 new tests (10 in `test_recipe_distillation.py` for model/store updates, 10 in `test_furnace_api.py` for router CRUD/feature-flag). All 69 furnace tests pass. Remaining: concierge chat-referenceable sessions (2-6), preference capture (2-7), variant comparison UI (3-5–3-8), notebook-specific prompts (6-2–6-4), term dedup (8-3), citation graph (8-5), integration/migration/frontend tests (9-2–9-4).

To make light mode feel truly live instead of only changing Monaco, `index.css` now includes a scoped light-mode compatibility bridge for older dark-only shell tokens, and the highest-visibility Development/Research shells plus `SettingsPanel` were updated to use explicit light/dark classes. - [fix] **Tool-loop routing and native provider compatibility hardening.** `triage.py` now falls back to heuristic `write_file` / `read_file` / `search_web` / `workflow_edit` action hints when the triage LLM returns unparseable output, so short follow-ups like "update it" no longer lose `file_write` enforcement and drift into read-only detours. `AnthropicProvider` and `GoogleProvider` now natively translate DAN's OpenAI-style tool schemas and assistant/tool transcript format into Claude `tool_use`/`tool_result` and Gemini function-call/function-response payloads, so tool-using chat no longer depends on the default OpenAI-compatible provider for those models. `OpenAIProvider` still preserves extra OpenAI-compatible tool-call metadata (including Gemini-style `thought_signature`) for proxy/router deployments, and post-tool recovery/synthesis prompts now describe the real failure class instead of always claiming a timeout. Review pass caught 8 issues: backend/frontend model mismatch (status enums, field names), `paper_queue` naming conflict with multi-source, missing source-addition API, missing PDF read→distill bridge, variant identity at wrong level (moved from RecipeVersion to FurnaceSession), missing recipe export wiring, two overlapping UIs needing clear roles, and wrong priority ordering. All patched.
- [fix] **Packaged app chat history now survives restart.** Fixed two release-only persistence bugs in `editor/electron/main.ts`: (1) the production UI server previously used `listen(0)`, so each launch got a different `http://127.0.0.1:<random-port>` origin and all frontend `localStorage` state (workspace store, per-mode sidebar chats, session restore, layout prefs, etc.) appeared to reset on every restart; it now binds to a fixed loopback port `45173`. (2) the packaged backend inherited the default relative `DAN_GRAPHS_DIR=./graphs`, so server-side chat threads/graphs/test cases depended on an arbitrary current working directory; it now forces `DAN_GRAPHS_DIR` to `app.getPath("userData")/graphs` for a stable per-user storage location. Follow-up hardening: added an Electron single-instance lock so relaunching the packaged app focuses the existing window instead of racing the fixed backend/UI ports. Validation: `npm run electron:compile` passes; the broader `editor npm run build` is currently blocked by an unrelated pre-existing TypeScript error in `src/components/code/MergeEditor.tsx` (`theme` is undefined).
- [fix] **Visible chat entry follow-up for Research + Development.** The prior per-mode chat work left the entry point technically present but still too easy to miss. Development mode now has a clearly labeled `AI Chat` button in the top editor toolbar in addition to the activity-bar icon, and Research mode now has both a stronger pill-styled `Chat` toggle in the left rail and a matching labeled `AI Chat` button in the top desk toolbar. This makes the chat entry visibly discoverable even before users know `⌘J`.
- [fix] **Chat layout follow-up: 6 cleanups from review pass.** (1) Removed dead `messagesEndRef` (ref declaration + `<div ref={messagesEndRef} />` marker) — orphaned after replacing `scrollIntoView` with direct `scrollTop`. (2) Fixed EmptyState vertical centering in fullScreen — the `max-w-3xl mx-auto` inner wrapper lacked height so EmptyState's `h-full` + `justify-center` couldn't center; now conditionally adds `h-full` to the wrapper when messages are empty. (3) Fixed EmptyState dark-mode colors — heading was `text-gray-800` (invisible on `#1e1e1e`), prompt cards used `bg-gray-50`/`border-gray-100`; changed to `text-gray-200`, `bg-white/5`, `border-gray-700` with `hover:bg-indigo-500/10`. (4) Fixed `queueStrip` dark-mode colors — `border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/50` and white queue items were jarring in fullScreen; now uses `border-[#3c3c3c] bg-[#252526]` with `bg-white/5 border-gray-700` items. (5) Changed main content column from `overflow-hidden` to `overflow-clip` — `overflow-hidden` creates a scroll container per CSS spec (root cause of the original `scrollIntoView` bug); `overflow-clip` prevents overflow without creating a scroll target. (6) Improved streaming scroll — replaced `smooth` scroll during content updates with instant scroll only when user is already near bottom (within 120px), preventing animation lag during rapid streaming and respecting manual scroll-back.
- [fix] **Chat layout: input no longer blocks entire page.** Two issues fixed: (1) `scrollIntoView()` on the messages-end marker was scrolling ALL scrollable ancestors, including the parent `overflow-hidden` flex-col container (which CSS spec treats as a scroll container). This pushed the conversation header, mode selector, and input area off their correct positions. Replaced all three `scrollIntoView` calls with direct `scrollTop`/`scrollTo` on a new `messagesContainerRef` targeting only the `overflow-y-auto` messages div. (2) Simplified the fragile 3-layer absolute positioning chain (ModePanel → ChatMode → ChatPanel all used `absolute inset-0`) to a single absolute layer (ModePanel) with pure flex layout below: ChatMode root changed from `absolute inset-0 h-full min-h-0` to `h-full flex flex-col`; ChatMode wrapper from `flex-1 min-h-0 h-full relative` to `flex-1 min-h-0`; ChatPanel outer from `absolute inset-0 h-full` to `relative h-full`; ChatPanel main column removed conflicting `h-full` (redundant with `flex-1`); bottomDock removed redundant `mt-auto` (flex-1 on messagesArea already handles it).
- [feat] **UX review patch — 9 improvements across Chat & Development modes.** (1) **Chat dark mode:** Eliminated jarring light/dark sandwich by giving ChatPanel's fullScreen layout a dark theme (`bg-[#1e1e1e]`/`bg-[#252526]`) for header, mode selector, input area, and thread list sidebar — matches the dark chrome of WorkspaceTabs and ModeBar. (2) **Thread discoverability:** ThreadTabs now always renders (even with 0 threads), shows a History toggle that dispatches `chat:toggleHistory` to ChatPanel, and has a visible New Thread (+) button. Dark-themed to match chrome. (3) **Activity bar grouping:** Added `ActivitySeparator` dividers between 4 logical groups — Core IDE (Files/Search/Git), Build & Quality (Extensions/Tasks/Testing), Navigation & Debug (Timeline/Outline/Debug), and DAN-specific (Workflow/Furnace). Reduces cognitive load from 11 unlabeled icons. (4) **AI Chat prominence:** AI Chat button in activity bar now uses a blue accent color (`text-blue-400`) instead of generic gray, making it visually distinct as the app's differentiating feature. (5) **ModeChatSidebar bridge:** Added "Open in Chat Mode" button (Maximize2 icon) to sidebar header + hint text in empty state ("Open full Chat for threads, / commands & history") to guide users to the richer chat experience. (6) **Code-to-chat shortcut:** Registered `Cmd+Shift+A` Monaco editor action "Ask DAN about Selection" that sends selected code to the sidebar chat with file path context. Complements existing right-click menu item. (7) **Cmd+W undo:** Thread close via Cmd+W now shows an info toast with 5-second "Undo" action button (via `openThread`) instead of silently closing. (8) **Workspace naming:** Removed auto-rename from "Scratch" to "Research Project" on mode switch — workspaces are mode-agnostic and shouldn't imply mode affinity. Cleaned up unused `activeWsName` selector. (9) **Mode selector dark theme:** Chat sub-mode buttons (Auto/Agent/Ask/Plan/Debug) now use dark-appropriate styling in fullScreen while preserving light theme in sidebar contexts.
- [fix] **ModeChatSidebar: flush pending save on unmount, cancel timer on clear.** The 500ms debounced save introduced in the earlier code-review patch silently dropped messages when the sidebar was hidden within the debounce window. Added a separate unmount-only effect that flushes the pending save via refs to latest state. Also patched `handleClear` to null the save timer before resetting messages, preventing a race where the old timer fires and re-persists cleared data.
- [fix] **Code review patch — 5 critical + 4 quality fixes.** (1) ChatMode: replaced unstable `getActiveWorkspace()` Zustand selector (new object ref every call → infinite re-renders) with primitive `activeWorkspaceId` selector. (2) ModeChatSidebar: added DOMPurify sanitization on `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` markdown output to prevent XSS from LLM responses. (3) ModeChatSidebar: moved `threadId` from `useState` to `useRef` so `doSend` always reads the current value instead of a stale closure. (4) CodeMode Cmd+S: was calling `markFileSaved()` without `nativeFs.writeFile()` — file marked clean but never written to disk. Now writes first, marks saved on success. (5) CodeMode: removed unused `reopenClosedFile` selector/dep from `useCodeShortcuts` (wasted re-bind on every store update). Also: moved module-level `zenPending`/`zenTimeout` into `useRef` to survive strict-mode double-mounts; extracted `MAX_PERSISTED_MESSAGES` constant; removed trivial `handleCloseThread` wrapper in ChatMode; added `dark:bg-gray-950` to ChatMode container.
- [fix] **Chat surface follow-up polish.** Hardened Chat mode's full-screen layout so the composer stays docked to the bottom of the viewport, split Code mode's activity bar into a scrollable tool stack plus pinned bottom utility controls so `AI Chat` remains visible after adding Workflow/Furnace, and promoted Research mode's chat entry from a tiny icon to a labeled `Chat` toggle beside `Context`. No chat-history cleanup is required for these fixes because sidebar visibility is local UI state, not persisted history.
- [feat] **Shell Chrome Purge & Per-Mode Chat (Plan 1-9).** Deleted 3 redundant shell layers totaling ~330px of wasted space: `Breadcrumb` (22px), `SidebarHost` (264px), `PersistentChatBar` (44px). Removed 5 dead state fields from `useAppStore` (`sidebarOpen`, `toggleSidebar`, `chatBarExpanded`, `setChatBarExpanded`, `pendingChatMessage`/`setPendingChatMessage`). - [docs] **Created Plan 1-9: Shell Chrome Purge & Per-Mode Chat.** UX audit found 3 redundant shell layers (Breadcrumb 22px, SidebarHost 264px, PersistentChatBar 44px) that contribute zero unique information — every mode already builds its own sidebar internally. Plan covers: (A) delete all three shell components, (B) extract a shared `ModeChatSidebar` with persistent per-workspace history for every non-Chat mode, (C) add Workflow + Furnace activity bar items to Development mode, (D) improve Research right-drawer discoverability.
- [fix] **Progress events no longer terminate client stream.** Changed `_emit_progress()` `detected_mode` from `"progress_generation"` to `"progress_ack"` so eval harness and editor frontend treat keepalive progress events correctly instead of interpreting them as terminal `chat_complete` events.
- [fix] **Quality gate now respects threshold=0 (accept all).** `DAN_GRAPH_QUALITY_THRESHOLD` used `> 0` check, so the default value "0" fell through to tier-adaptive thresholds that reject graphs. Changed sentinel from 0 to -1 for "not set", and condition from `> 0` to `>= 0`. Now: env var unset → tier-adaptive; env var = "0" → no rejection; env var = N → reject below N.
- [fix] **Tool catalog now included in live intent extraction.** The chat_manager intent extraction path built messages without the available tool_id list, so the LLM could invent non-existent tool IDs. Now imports `render_tool_id_list` and appends the catalog to the system prompt, matching the behavior in `extract_workflow_intent()`.
- [feat] **Added `pre_generation_ms` to `ChatGenerationSummaryEvent`.** New optional field tracks pre-generation latency in the summary event. Wired into `_build_summary_event()` (currently `None`; TODO: populate from intent extraction timing).
- [fix] **Structural mutation macros now handle flat edge lists.** `structural_mutations.py` assumed edges were `{"data": [...], "control": [...]}` but the canonical `Graph` model uses a flat `edges: list[Edge]` with `edge_type` discriminator. Added `_get_edges_by_type()` and `_remove_data_edge()` helpers; updated all 5 edge functions and 12 call sites across `wrap_in_review_loop`, `fan_out_node`, `insert_validator`, `insert_tool`, `parallelize`, and `summarize_graph`. Both formats now supported.
- [fix] **Eval harness correctness fixes (10 items).** (1) `.gitignore` re-includes `tests/eval/` and `tests/test_eval_runner.py` so the harness is version-controlled. (2) `run_multi_turn()` now updates `graph_revision` from graph metadata and only checks fixture expectations on the final turn. (3) Durability D2/D4 use `len(errors) == 0` instead of the non-existent `validation["valid"]` field; D4 adds a 3s delay after `send_message` before re-reading. (4) `run_single()` now also calls `_any_event_needs_clarification(events)`, not just `_needs_clarification_reply(response_text)`. (5) `guard_events` field on `EvalRecord` is now populated from stream events. (6) `_run_durability()` requires `validation.passed` when selecting a graph for durability checks. (7) `_validate()` now extracts `message` from dict errors and uses `len(errors) == 0` (same fix as durability). (8) `_try_execute()` now populates `nodes_completed` via `get_run_telemetry()`. (9) `run_tokens` field wired via new `_query_run_tokens()` that queries `workflow_run` telemetry events. (10) `multi_turn_history` now populated in `run_multi_turn()` with the accumulated conversation history.

## 2026-03-15
- [fix] **Chat UI: removed duplicate "Scratch" label and fixed chatbox jump on Enter.** Two issues: (1) `WorkspaceContextBar` inside `ChatMode.tsx` displayed the workspace name redundantly — already visible in `WorkspaceTabs` and `SidebarHost` header. Removed the component from `ChatMode` render tree. (2) Textarea auto-resize used `useEffect` (fires after paint), causing a visible height flash when the input text cleared on send. Switched `adjustTextarea` to `useLayoutEffect` (fires before paint) and changed intermediate height from `"auto"` to `"0"` to prevent the textarea from momentarily expanding to full content height during measurement. Also changed auto-scroll on new messages from `useEffect` to `useLayoutEffect` with instant scroll for new messages, preventing a one-frame lag where the layout shifts before the scroll catches up.
- [fix] **Second review pass: fixed follow-up regressions and deeper test drift.** Patched two real regressions in `ChatPanel.tsx`: `pendingChatMessage` now uses a live store subscription so cross-mode sends still work after Chat has already mounted once, and thread-delete undo now restores into a newly created thread id before reloading the conversation. Hardened `SQLiteTelemetryStore` by switching from one long-lived shared SQLite connection to per-operation connections, eliminating the teardown crash/segfault path seen under the full pytest run. Updated stale tests to match the post-router/startup refactors and direct-build path: `test_chat_integration.py` now patches `startup._build_chat_provider_registry` and uses reconnect-aware queue collection, `test_adapter_concierge_bridge.py` patches `routers.adapters.get_dispatcher`, `test_app_mcp_startup.py` targets `startup.py` helpers, `test_audit.py` drops removed `reuse_decision` expectations, `test_capability_exposure.py` patches the moved tool functions / new defaults, and `test_build_from_intent.py` plus `test_chat_codegen_integration.py` now reflect the current direct-build/codegen split. Validation: `editor npm run build` passes and `pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/test_eval_runner.py -q --tb=no` now passes end-to-end (`6308 passed, 20 skipped, 48 deselected`).
- [fix] **Comprehensive bug fix sprint (Tiers 1–4, 22 items).** Fixed across backend, editor, CLI, and tests: **Backend:** `execute_plan_direct` graph_data→graph key fix; MetaController timeout (DAN_META_TIMEOUT, 600s default); DAN_FULL_TOOLS defaults on; workspace sandbox logging; LLMAuthenticationError for 401/403 in all providers; /goal command registered. **Editor build:** 97 TS errors fixed across 37 files; `npm run build` passes. **Editor UI:** PersistentChatBar store-based pending message (race fix); Paperclip removed; stale-revision "Retry with current" button; ConnectionBanner for backend health; SlashCommandPopup for / commands; ConfirmDialog replaces native confirm(); soft-delete with undo toast. **Tests:** 18 test files fixed (stale mocks, imports, assertions); 91→33 failures, 5830+ passing. **CLI:** dan-editor command. **Research:** Chat stream events bridged to research event router. **Tier 4:** researchEventDemo.ts @internal; DIRECT_TASK reconnect verified; Phase 21 /goal partially wired; provider quota errors handled.
- [feat] **Standalone macOS app build.** Modified `electron/main.ts` to auto-spawn `dan-serve --no-reload` as a child process in production mode and run a local HTTP+WebSocket proxy server that serves the built frontend and proxies `/api/*` to the backend — so all relative API paths work with zero frontend changes. Updated `package.json` with description/author, fixed `dist:mac` script with CXXFLAGS for macOS SDK C++ headers. Built and verified DMG+ZIP at `editor/release/`. The app can now be installed independently from the development tree.
- [docs] **Created and reviewed Code Mode Production Patch plan (1-8).** New UI subplan `1-8-code-mode-patch.md` addressing the gap between "180 checkboxes complete" and production-ready IDE. Four slices: (A) fix ~70 TypeScript build errors + single-launch Electron experience + first-run onboarding; (B) wire LSP to OutlineView/SymbolSearch/PeekDefinition instead of regex fallbacks, add Go/Rust/C++ language servers; (C) @ references in chat sidebar + multi-file agent edit flow + project-aware AI context; (D) implement or remove `/cost`+`/retry` (handlers never written), debug QoL, editor reliability. Review pass verified all LSP claims against source (confirmed regex-only with placeholder comments), corrected 2 phantom claims (PersistentChatBar has no Paperclip button; `/cost`+`/retry` handlers don't exist to "fix"), narrowed stale-revision scope (main fix already landed 2026-03-12), marked `MultiFileEdit.tsx` sub-tasks 9-2/9-3 as already done, noted Go/Rust/C++ servers are system binaries not npm packages, confirmed `persistent-chat:send` race is real. Updated master UI spec (Phase 5) and todo.md.
- [fix] **Tool-loop follow-up timeout now retries and falls back to DAN_LLM_MODEL.** When the post-tool-call LLM follow-up timed out, the only recovery was a single no-tools synthesis using the same stalled model — systematically slow providers (e.g. glm-5) caused 5+ consecutive timeouts with no self-healing. Fixed three gaps: (1) transient errors (timeout, rate limit, connection) now trigger one retry with 3s backoff before falling through to synthesis; (2) if same-model synthesis fails and `effective_model` differs from `self._chat_model`, a second synthesis attempt resolves the fallback provider for `DAN_LLM_MODEL`; (3) timeout is already classified as transient in the initial-call path but was missing from the follow-up — now consistent.

- [fix] **Removed a Zustand selector loop in `FileExplorer` tree nodes.** `TreeNode` subscribed with `useCodeStore((s) => s.openFiles.map((f) => f.path))`, which creates a fresh array on every render. In Zustand v5, derived selectors that return new references can trigger `useSyncExternalStore` re-render loops; opening a folder mounted many `TreeNode` instances and crashed Development mode with `Maximum update depth exceeded`. Replaced that selector with a stable boolean lookup (`some(...)`) scoped to the current entry.
- [fix] **Bundled editor language-server binaries locally.** Added `pyright`, `typescript-language-server`, and `vscode-langservers-extracted` to the editor devDependencies, then switched `lspManager.ts` to launch bundled servers via `npx --no-install`. This removes the noisy `spawn pyright-langserver ENOENT` failure in Python workspaces and aligns the JSON/CSS/HTML launcher names with the actual installed binaries.
- [fix] **Made frontend mode UI workspace-specific.** Keyed `AppShell`'s `SidebarHost` and mode viewport by `activeWorkspaceId` so mode-local React state remounts cleanly per workspace instead of bleeding across tabs. Tightened per-workspace mode/session typing (`Workspace.lastActiveMode`, `WorkspaceSession.lastActiveMode` as `AppMode`), simplified session saves to persist mode directly, and moved workspace session restore to `useLayoutEffect` so switching workspaces applies the correct mode/UI state before paint. Follow-up race fix: `useSyncWorkspaceMode` now skips the first render after a workspace switch, and the per-workspace autosave effect no longer re-saves the outgoing workspace during cleanup with the newly restored mode. Follow-up UI fix: the sidebar shell and viewport now use distinct React keys (`sidebar-*` / `viewport-*`) so repeated workspace switches do not accumulate extra layout layers. Follow-up terminal fix: `TerminalPanel` now reattaches to existing terminal tabs on remount instead of always spawning a new process, and workspace switches explicitly kill outgoing workspace terminals before code state reset so terminal tabs no longer multiply on each switch.
- [fix] **Fixed "Maximum update depth exceeded" crash on folder open.** `useSyncWorkspaceMode` in `AppShell.tsx` used `getActiveWorkspace()` as a Zustand selector, returning a new object reference on every workspace store update and retriggering its own effect via `updateWorkspace`. Replaced with primitive-field selectors (`activeWsId`, `activeWsLastMode`, `activeWsName`) so effect deps are stable strings. Applied the same fix to `AppShell`'s render and `ResearchMode`'s `LibrarySection`/`FurnacePanel` which also subscribed to the full workspace object.
- [fix] **Silenced noisy ENOENT errors when opening non-Node folders.** The `fs:readFile` IPC handler in `main.ts` threw unhandled on missing files, producing repeated stack traces in the console when project detectors probed for `package.json` in non-Node folders. Now catches ENOENT and returns `null`, matching the renderer-side `nativeFs.readFile` contract (`Promise<string | null>`).

- [fix] **Chat input floated to the top after sending a message — Electron flex height chain broken.** Neither `h-full` chains nor `flex-1` chains reliably propagated height from `ModePanel (absolute inset-0)` → `ChatMode` → `ChatPanel` in Electron's Chromium. Browser worked fine; Electron did not — the conversation column got `height: auto` and `flex-1` on `messagesArea` had no space to grow. Fix: added a `position: relative` wrapper in `ChatMode` around `ChatPanel`, and changed `ChatPanel`'s fullscreen root to `position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex`. This bypasses all flex/percentage height propagation — dimensions come directly from absolute positioning against the wrapper. Also locked viewport with `html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden }`.
- [fix] **Refresh loaded the wrong chat — `ChatPanel` ignored workspace store.** `ChatPanel` read the saved thread from its own `localStorage` key (`dan_active_thread_${graphId}`), but the workspace store (zustand `persist` with key `dan-workspaces`) already tracks `activeThreadId` per workspace and rehydrates on refresh. On mount, the `useEffect` read from `localStorage` but the workspace store's value was the correct source of truth. Fix: initial thread loading now checks `useWorkspaceStore.getState().getActiveWorkspace()?.activeThreadId` first, falling back to `localStorage` and then `sorted[0]`.
- [fix] **Refresh loaded the first chat instead of the current one — race condition in localStorage persistence.** The `useEffect` that synced `activeThreadId` to `localStorage` fired on mount with `null`, clearing the saved value before the thread-loading effect could read it. Changed the effect to only write when `activeThreadId` is non-null; stale IDs in storage are safely ignored because the loader validates against the live thread list before using them.
- [feat] **Context-aware compaction ratio and pressure hint for long conversations.** The `_compact_context` compaction ratio was a fixed 55% of context window — too conservative for large windows (wasted ~20% of a 200K window). Now scales by window size: 80% for 1M+, 70% for 200K+, 65% for 128K+, 55% for smaller. Configurable via `DAN_COMPACT_CONTEXT_RATIO` env var. Added `context_pressure_hint()` in `chat/tokens.py` — when context usage exceeds 60% of the window (configurable via `DAN_CONTEXT_PRESSURE_THRESHOLD`), a system message is injected: "Save intermediate results to a file with file_write before making more tool calls. Keep your response concise." This gives the LLM a behavioral nudge without raw token counts, following the pattern used by Cursor/Claude Code (system-level management, not model-level arithmetic).
- [fix] **Stopped raw web search/fetch content from leaking into chat responses.** Replaced `combined_text_parts.append(cap_result.message)` in `chat_manager.py` with `_summarize_tool_result()` — a new helper in `chat/helpers.py` that produces one-line summaries like `Searched web for "X" (5 results)` or `Fetched https://... (4,200 chars)` instead of dumping raw content. This fixes 7 fallback paths (cancellation, continuation failure, empty LLM response, timeout, synthesis failure) that previously dumped raw web/file content to the user. Added explicit "never paste raw search results" instruction to the research prompt. Reinforces existing NON-NEGOTIABLE rules 7 and 8.
- [fix] **Initial LLM call timeout now falls back to text-only stream instead of hard-stopping.** Previously, `asyncio.TimeoutError` on the initial `provider.complete()` returned a generic "took too long" message and abandoned the request. Now timeouts are treated like other transient errors — retried once, then fall back to `_stream_with_json_fallback()` (text-only, no tools) before giving up. This gives the user a response instead of a dead end.
- [fix] **Mid-loop timeout now attempts synthesis recovery before dumping.** When the LLM times out during the multi-turn tool loop, the system now tries a no-tools synthesis call asking the model to answer from the tool results already in context. If synthesis succeeds, the user gets a proper response. If it also fails, the error message now includes a bullet-point summary of completed tool steps (from the new `_summarize_tool_result` output) so "continue" has context about what was already done.

## 2026-03-13
- [fix] **Migrated `ChatMessage.tsx` custom markdown renderer to marked v17 token-based API.** The `marked` library was upgraded to v17 which changed the Renderer contract: methods now receive raw token objects instead of pre-rendered HTML strings. The custom renderer was still using the old API, causing tables to render as `[object Object]`, lists as `undefined`, and inline formatting (bold, italic, links) to show raw markdown. Updated all 13 renderer methods (`heading`, `paragraph`, `blockquote`, `table`, `tablecell`, `list`, `listitem`, `strong`, `em`, `del`, `link`, plus kept `code`/`codespan`/`hr` unchanged) to use `this.parser.parseInline(tokens)` for inline content and `this.parser.parse(tokens)` for block content. Switched from arrow functions to regular `function` expressions where `this.parser` access is needed. Zero TypeScript errors, zero linter warnings.
- [feat] **Inject message into active session ("Push" button).** The first queued message now has a "Push" button that injects the message into the active streaming session via `POST /api/chat/{channel}/inject`. The backend `ChatManager` maintains per-stream injection queues; between tool rounds in the multi-turn tool loop, injected messages are drained and appended to the LLM context as user messages. A `ChatInjectedMessageEvent` is emitted on the WebSocket so the frontend inserts the injected message into the conversation above the assistant's ongoing response. This lets users provide additional context or redirect the assistant mid-turn without waiting for the current response to finish.
- [feat] **Message queue: type and queue follow-up messages while DAN is still processing.** When streaming is active, the composer stays enabled with a "Type to queue next message…" placeholder. Enter enqueues the message instead of silently dropping it. Queued messages appear in a strip below the composer with edit (pop back to input), reorder (move up), and delete actions. When the active stream completes, the next queued message auto-sends after a 100ms delay. Queue is cleared on thread switch or new chat. `beforeunload` handler and component unmount both call `shutdownAllBackgroundStreams()` to close all detached WebSockets and flush pending saves when the app closes.
- [feat] **Background streaming: chat sessions keep running when switching threads.** Replaced the bouncing-dots loading placeholder with the progress status text at the top of the assistant bubble. Added clickable "open" link next to file paths in progress text. New `backgroundStreamRegistry.ts` module detaches the active WebSocket into a background registry when switching threads — the stream continues saving to the server and the thread list shows a pulsing indigo dot for threads working in the background. When the background stream completes, the active thread auto-reloads the latest state.
- [refactor] **Replaced hand-rolled markdown renderer with `marked` for proper CommonMark parsing.** `ChatMessage.tsx` now uses the `marked` library with custom renderers for DAN-styled headings, tables, code blocks (hljs), blockquotes, and links. Tables that follow text without a blank line now render correctly instead of showing raw pipe syntax. Math (KaTeX) and @mention extraction still use the placeholder system before `marked` processes the rest. All 66 editor tests pass.
- [fix] **Tiered executor `ChatManager` bridge now preserves request safety metadata.** The initial concierge rewrite fix restored the correct `send_message_with_tools(workflow_id, message, history, ...)` call shape, but the bridge was still dropping `client_graph_revision`, `debug_context`, `mentions`, and triage-derived `required_action_hints`, and it defaulted mutation access too broadly. `tier_executors.py` now forwards the full request envelope that `ChatManager` expects, derives `allow_mutation_tool` conservatively from the `workflow_edit` action hint when no explicit override is present, and falls back to `session_id` for thread continuity. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py` to lock the metadata bridge and workflow-edit mutation gating in place.
- [fix] **Review hardening for the concierge rewrite.** Removed the last hidden legacy branches and references from live code: inlined task-state persistence instead of importing deleted `resume.py`, removed the dead `memory_bridge` / `solver` bootstrap path, extracted workflow handoff assembly out of the deleted `boundary_handoff.py`, dropped unreachable follow-up startup wiring, removed stale reuse-decision audit fields, and cleaned the remaining legacy clarify/reuse metadata handling. Rewired triage-gathered memory/file/domain context into tier executor prompts, restored fast-command dependency injection for `/help`, `/skill`, `/schedule`, `/plan`, `/pii`, and `/computer`, reinstated scheduler-store initialization so the kept scheduling subsystem can start, tightened root task finalization for failed/cancelled sessions, and refreshed `docs/architecture.md` to match the rebuilt runtime.
